about_the_game:
Welcome to Mistway — A World Where Perspective is Everything

Mistway is a tradition-defying 3D spatial puzzle game. Here, you control not just a ball, but the very perspective through which you view the world. By shifting your viewpoint, you reshape reality, turning towering walls into clear paths and bottomless chasms into solid bridges.

Core Gameplay: Shift Your View, Solve the Puzzle

  • Dynamic Space Construction: Freely switch between various perspectives, such as Top-down and Side-view. Each shift reveals entirely new paths for you to discover.

  • Simplify Complexity: Transform intricate 3D mazes into the familiar formats of 2D platformers or flat maps through perspective shifts, making challenges intuitive and logical.

  • Paradoxical Journey: Experience visual and mental paradoxes where "a dead end from above becomes a passageway from the front." Continuously break your preconceived notions of space and distance.

Game Features

  • Innovative Core Mechanic: The "perspective-shifting puzzle" delivers an unprecedented brain-teasing experience and the profound satisfaction of a sudden "Eureka!" moment.

  • Extensive Level Design: Over 40 meticulously crafted levels with multiple unforeseen routes to completion, offering both challenge and immense fun.

  • Personalized Journey: Equip your ball with a variety of unique skins, allowing you to embark on this intellectual adventure in a style that's all your own.

Ready to Challenge Your Spatial Imagination?

Add Mistway to your wishlist now and embark on this marvelous journey that subverts perception and ignites the mind!

short_description: Mistway is an innovative physics-based puzzle game where shifting your perspective is the key. In this enigmatic cube-based labyrinth, rotate your view to alter the very physics of the world. Unlock the secrets of 3D space, turn the impossible into possible, and guide your ball to the destination.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
